people.name: maya
people.about: Maya, the product manager who asked for this feature. She knows what is wanted, not how the code works.

topics.topic: which type a customer gets when none is chosen, and whether the default type itself can be deleted
topics.says: A customer created without a type gets the default type. The default type itself can't be deleted: someone has to make another type the default first.

topics.topic: which permission staff need to manage customer types and customer attributes
topics.says: Managing customer types and customer attributes takes the customer-type permission. The product and page permissions don't cover it.

topics.topic: whether the values of customer attributes can be translated
topics.says: No. Values of customer attributes can't be translated.

people.name: sam
people.about: Sam, the owner of `core`, who is building the API side of this feature at the same time.

topics.topic: when the API side of the feature (core's part) will be on `main` of `core`, or how far along it is
topics.says: I'm still building the API side. I'll tell you here the moment it is on `main` of `core`; I can't give you a time.

topics.topic: what the API will look like: the names and shapes of the queries, mutations, types and fields core is adding
topics.says: I'd rather not describe the API before it is on `main`: names are still moving. Once it is deployed, the schema `http://core:8000/graphql/` serves is the contract.

pushes.says: The customer types and customer attributes API is going onto `main` of `core` now. CI deploys it, which takes a few minutes; after that it is what `http://core:8000/graphql/` serves.
pushes.message: Customer types and customer attributes in the API
